Kardbord's Boxes

Custom build specifications for upstream FOSS projects. Built by OBS and GitHub Actions. Flatpaks, RPMs, and DEBs.

Flatpak Repository

Flatpak apps and extensions are hosted as OCI images on GHCR, with the index served from GitHub Pages. Extensions mount automatically into any app built on the io.github.kardbord.Platform runtime.

Quick Start

flatpak remote-add --if-not-exists --user {{ .RemoteName }} \
oci+{{ .PagesURL }}

Then install the apps you want:

flatpak install {{ .RemoteName }} io.github.kardbord.neovim
flatpak install {{ .RemoteName }} io.github.kardbord.tool.ripgrep
flatpak install {{ .RemoteName }} io.github.kardbord.tool.fd

Pass additional --filesystem= flags as needed. See the Flatpak guide for developer documentation.

Distro Packages (OBS)

RPM and DEB packages are published to the Open Build Service and can be added to your system's package manager.

RPM-based (openSUSE, Rocky Linux, Alma Linux)

REPO_URL="https://download.opensuse.org/repositories/home:/Kardbord:/Boxes//home:Kardbord:Boxes.repo"
sudo zypper addrepo --refresh "$REPO_URL" # openSUSE
sudo dnf config-manager --add-repo "$REPO_URL" # Rocky/Alma
sudo zypper refresh # or: sudo dnf makecache
sudo zypper install

Debian-based (Ubuntu, Debian, Raspbian)

REPO_URL="https://download.opensuse.org/repositories/home:/Kardbord:/Boxes/"
curl -fsSL "$REPO_URL/Release.key" | gpg --dearmor \
| sudo tee /usr/share/keyrings/home_Kardbord_Boxes.gpg > /dev/null
echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/home_Kardbord_Boxes.gpg] $REPO_URL/ ./" \
| sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/home:Kardbord:Boxes.list
sudo apt update
sudo apt install

Replace <REPOSITORY> with your distribution's repo name (e.g. openSUSE_Tumbleweed, RockyLinux_9, Debian_13) and <PACKAGE> with a package name from the README.
